intendedObjective: Reconstruct the orientation note into clear, friendly instructions for a new volunteer.
acceptableEditScope: Rewrite and organize the wording while retaining actual steps and responsibilities; add no procedures.
stableFactsAndClaims: Get an apron from the cupboard beneath the sink on arrival.
Payment handling and drink preparation are distinct; new volunteers do not handle payments on their first shift.
The shift leader pairs the new volunteer with a drink preparer who shows order slips and the washing station.
Return the used apron to the laundry basket next to the cupboard and tell the leader verbally before leaving.
An unwell volunteer must tell the leader immediately and stop handling drinks.

voiceConstraints: Clear, friendly, ordinary language addressed to a new volunteer.
